blocks.en: The human brain effortlessly deciphers colors and textures from visual stimuli and reconstructs the world around us, yet preserving such details remains challenging in image denoising. While significant progress has been made in generic image denoising, the problem of texture denoising has remained relatively under-explored. Fine details, such as intricate patterns and repetitive structures, often suffer from over-smoothing even in deep learning based approaches for denoising. In this paper, we analyze the behavior of state-of-the-art (SOTA) denoisers on texture datasets and show that performance improvements are possible only by fine-tuning the denoisers on the texture datasets. Surprisingly, fine-tuning on texture datasets result in the models catastrophically forgetting the original dataset. These findings highlight the need for specialized treatment of textures in denoising. Since denoising quality directly impacts downstream tasks such as generative modelling, we argue that dedicated texture aware denoisers are essential for faithful texture reconstruction and synthesis.
blocks.zh: 人类的大脑不懈地从视觉刺激中分辨出颜色和纹理,并重建了我们周围的世界,然而,保存这些细节在图像解密方面仍然具有挑战性。 虽然在通俗形象去名化方面取得了重大进展,但纹理去名化问题仍然相对没有得到充分探讨. 细微的细节,例如复杂的模式和重复的结构,往往过于舒缓,即使是在深层次的以学习为基础的消遣方法中也是如此。 在本文中,我们分析最先进的(SOTA)denoisers在纹理数据集上的行为,并显示只有微调了纹理数据集上的denoisers才能改进性能. 令人惊讶的是,对纹理数据集的微调导致模型灾难性地忘记了原始数据集. 这些调查结果突出表明,在去诺化时需要专门处理纹理. 由于去Noing质素直接影响到下游的任务,例如基因建模,所以我们主张,专用的纹理感知分泌器对于忠实的纹理重建和合成至关重要.

blocks.en: Most imaging techniques inevitably introduce noise, which is further exacerbated by environmental conditions, varying lighting conditions and transmission errors. This results in distortion, loss of image information, and overall degradation in visual quality. The presence of noise adversely impacts subsequent image/video processing/analysis tasks. Consequently, image denoising is a critical component of modern image processing pipelines. Image denoising is central to denoising diffusion models [ 10 , 15 ] which are SOTA generative models.
blocks.zh: 大多数成像技术不可避免地会引入噪音,环境条件,不同照明条件和传输出错使噪音进一步加剧. 这导致图像信息被扭曲,丢失,视觉质量整体退化. 噪音的存在对随后的图像/视频处理/分析任务产生不利影响。 因此,图像消音是现代图像处理管道的重要组成部分。 图像去诺是去诺扩散模型[10,15]的核心,这些模型是SOTA基因模型.

blocks.en: The goal of image denoising is to recover the pristine image 𝐱 ∈ ℝ m {\bf x}\in\mathbb{R}^{m} from its noisy observation 𝐲 ∈ ℝ m {\bf y}\in\mathbb{R}^{m} . However, since perfect restoration is not possible, the aim is to estimate 𝐱 \bf x as accurately as possible. Noise introduces distortions that obscure important details, making estimation of 𝐱 \bf x a challenging task. The most commonly used observation model is 𝐲 = 𝐱 + 𝐧 \bf y=x+n , where 𝐧 ∈ ℝ m {\bf n}\in\mathbb{R}^{m} denotes additive white Gaussian noise. The objective is to develop a denoising method that produces an estimate of the clean image 𝐱 ^ \bf\hat{x} that is as close as possible to the ground truth 𝐱 \bf x .
Fig. 1 : Comparison of a noisy and denoised texture using pretrained MIRNet [ 23 ] and its finetuned version (MIRNet † ). PSNR and SSIM values improve after finetuning.
blocks.zh: 图1:使用预先训练的MIRNet[23]及其微调版本(MIRNet + )对噪音和去声纹理进行比较。 PSNR和SSIM的数值在微调后得到改进.

blocks.en: Fig. 2 : Visual comparison of various denoising models on the NUUR-Texture500 [ 14 ] dataset. Top row : noisy and pre-trained model results, bottom row : reference and (Model † ) fine-tuned models. PSNR is shown for each result relative to the reference.
blocks.zh: 图2:NUUR-Texture500 [14]数据集上各种去名模型的可视比较. 上行 : 吵闹并预加训练的模型结果,下行 : 参考和 (Model †)微调模型. PSNR 相对于引用显示每个结果.

blocks.en: Despite significant progress, most deep learning techniques focus on generic image denoising, with limited analysis on specialized classes such as textures. The objective of this paper is to fill this gap. In image processing, texture can be defined as a function of spatial variation of the brightness intensity of the pixels [ 19 ] . Natural textures involve fine details and repetitive elements with some degree of stochasticity that are particularly sensitive to noise.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了显著进展,但大多数深层学习技术都以通用图像去诺化为重点,对纹理等专业类的分析有限. 本文件的目的是填补这一空白。 在图像处理中,纹理可以被定义为像素亮度强度空间变异[19]. 自然纹理涉及细细的细节和重复性元素,有一定程度的花纹,对噪音特别敏感.

blocks.en: As a result, most conventional denoising methods tend to blur intricate patterns in textures, making texture preservation more challenging than generic image denoising. Figure 1 illustrates that a deep learning model trained on standard image denoising datasets performs poorly on texture images, both quantitatively and qualitatively. Fine-tuning the model on a texture dataset enhances the performance, highlighting the need for texture-aware denoising strategies.
blocks.zh: 因此,大多数传统的去诺化方法往往会模糊纹理中错综复杂的图案,使去诺化的纹理保存比一般的图像去诺化更具挑战性. 图1显示,在标准图像去名数据集方面受过训练的深层学习模型在质和量两方面的纹理图像方面表现不佳。 在纹理数据集上精细地调整模型可以提高性能,凸显出纹理-知觉去诺化策略的必要性.

blocks.en: In this paper, our objective is to carry out a systematic study of the generalizability of deep learning techniques for denoising texture images. As argued in [ 28 ] , SSIM is inadequate for objective assessment of the quality of texture. Therefore, we employ alternative measures such as STSIM1 [ 28 ] , STSIM2 [ 28 ] , MS-SSIM [ 21 ] , CW-SSIM [ 18 ] and DISTS [ 6 ] in addition to PSNR and SSIM. Among these metrics, STSIM1 and STSIM2 are specifically designed for quality assessment of texture patterns.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们的目标是对去诺素图象的深层学习技术的通俗性进行系统的研究. 如[28]所述,SSIM不足以客观评估纹理质量. 因此,我们采用替代措施,如STSIM1 [28],STSIM2 [28],MS-SSIM [21],CW-SSIM [18]和DSTS [6],此外还有PSNR和SSIM. 在这些度量衡中,STSIM1和STSIM2是专门为纹理模式质量评估而设计的.

blocks.en: Classical image denoising methods include Gaussian smoothing, bilateral filtering, non-local means [ 2 ] , wavelet thresholding, and BM3D [ 5 ] . However, these approaches have been surpassed by SOTA deep learning techniques. Jain and Seung [ 12 ] first demonstrated the effectiveness of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for denoising, showing that CNNs could match or even surpass the performance of the then traditional models. Subsequently, with the introduction of SRCNN [ 8 ] and ARCNN [ 7 ] for super-resolution and JPEG artifact reduction, respectively, CNN-based methods have achieved impressive performance and have since become mainstream in the field of image restoration.
blocks.zh: 古典图像去诺方法包括高斯平滑法,双边过滤法,非局部手段 [2],波浪阈值法,和 BM3D [5]. 然而,这些方法已被SOTA深层学习技术所超越. Jain and Seung [12]首先演示了"革命神经网络"(CNNs)的去名效果,显示CNN可以匹配甚至超越当时传统模型的性能. 随后,随着SRCNN [8]和ARCNN [7] 分别用于超分辨率和JPEG文物削减,基于CNN的方法取得了令人印象深刻的性能,并自此成为图像修复领域的主流.

blocks.en: Denoising Autoencoders (DAEs) [ 20 ] introduced learning noise distributions to recover clean images via mapping inputs to meaningful intermediate representations. This was followed by CNN-based models such as DnCNN [ 26 ] , which leveraged deep residual learning [ 9 ] to effectively remove Gaussian noise. Originally proposed to address degradation of accuracy with the depth of the network, it was also found to improve performance in image classification and object detection.
blocks.zh: Denoising Autoencodeers (DAEs) [20] 引入了学习噪声分布法,通过对有意义的中间表示的绘图输入来回收干净的图像. 随后有CNN的模型,如DnCNN[26],利用了深残留学习[9]有效去除高斯噪音. 最初提议在网络深度范围内解决精度的退化问题,但也发现它改善了图像分类和物体检测方面的性能.

blocks.en: CNN-based denoising methods process images either at full resolution, preserving spatial details but lacking global contextual, or at reduced resolutions, capturing semantics but losing spatial accuracy. To address this trade-off, Multi-Scale Image Restoration Network (MIRNet) [ 23 ] employs parallel multi-scale feature extraction with attention-based aggregation, while Multi-Stage Progressive Image Restoration Network (MPRNet) [ 24 ] integrates contextual features extracted from an encoder-decoder network with a high-resolution branch that preserves local details. This ensures both spatial precision and strong contextual representation.
blocks.zh: 基于有线电视新闻网的解密方法处理图像时,要么是完全分辨率,保存空间细节,但缺乏全球背景,要么是分辨率降低,捕捉语义,但失去空间准确性。 为了解决这种取舍,多比例图像恢复网络(MIRNet)[23]采用并行的多比例特性提取并基于注意力的汇总,而多阶渐进图像恢复网络(MPRNet)[24]整合了从编码器-解码器网络中取出的背景特性,并设有高分辨率分支,保存了本地细节. 这确保了空间精确度和强烈的背景代表性。
(k) 《禁止酷刑和其他残忍、不人道或有辱人格的待遇或处罚公约》(CAT)

blocks.en: Most image-denoising algorithms are developed and evaluated on synthetic data, typically generated under the assumption of additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN). However, AWGN does not accurately represent real-world camera noise. CycleISP [ 22 ] addresses this by modeling the camera imaging pipeline in both forward and reverse directions, to generate realistic image pairs in both RAW and sRGB spaces.
blocks.zh: 大多数图像识别算法是在合成数据上得到开发和评价的,一般是在添加剂白高斯噪音(AWGN)的假设下产生的. 然而,特设工作组并不准确地代表现实世界的相机噪音。 CycleISP [22]通过在相机成像管的向前和向倒两个方向进行建模来解决这个问题,在RAW和SRGB两个空间生成现实的成像对.

blocks.en: Improving performance often increases computational cost. Nonlinear Activation Free Network (NAFNet) [ 3 ] mitigates this by removing or replacing nonlinear activations with multiplications, achieving improved performance with reduced complexity.
blocks.zh: 改进业绩往往会增加计算成本。 非线性活性自由网络(NAFNet)[3]通过去除或用乘法来取代非线性活性,实现性能的改善并降低复杂性来缓解这种情况.

blocks.en: To overcome CNN limitations such as restricted receptive fields and static filters, transformer-based models have been proposed. Restoration Transformer (Restormer) [ 25 ] leverages global context for SOTA restoration performance. But transformers with global attention are computationally expensive. To reduce the high computational cost of global attention, Cross Aggregation Transformer (CAT) [ 4 ] introduced rectangle-window self-attention. This approach applies horizontal and vertical rectangle window attention in parallel across different heads, expanding the attention area and enabling feature aggregation across windows.
blocks.zh: 为了克服CNN的限制,例如有限的可接受字段和静态过滤器,提出了以变压器为基础的模型. 恢复变形器(再暴星) [25] 为SOTA的恢复性能利用了全球背景. 但具有全球关注的变压器在计算上是昂贵的. 为了降低全球关注的高计算成本,Cross Aggregation Transformer (CAT) [4] 引入了矩形-窗口自意. 这种方法将横向和纵向矩形窗口的注意力平行地放在不同的头上,扩大了注意力范围,并使得各窗口之间能够进行特征汇总。

blocks.en: Despite the strong performance of modern CNN and transformer-based denoisers on synthetic Gaussian noise and real-world datasets such as SIDD [ 1 ] , their performance when the distribution of images shift to texture-rich ones remains unaddressed. It is important to understand the dissimilarities between natural images and textures. While textures are components of natural images, they differ structurally when considered independently. As defined by Portilla & Simoncelli [ 17 ] , “ An image of visual texture is spatially homogeneous and typically contains repeated structures, often with some random variation (e.g., random positions, orientations or colors).” In contrast, natural images have been observed to predominantly consist of smooth (low-pass) regions [ 11 ] . This characteristic is fundamentally different from textures, which may or may not exhibit smoothness. The presence of high-frequency spectral information, which is also present in noise, is what makes texture denoising challenging. In this paper, the objective is to validate and benchmark the performance of SOTA deep denoisers, specifically on textures.
blocks.zh: 尽管现代有线电视新闻网和以变压器为基础的Denoisers在合成高斯噪音和SIDD等现实世界数据集上表现出来很强的性能,但当图像的传播转向有纹理丰富的数据集时,它们的性能仍未得到解决. 了解自然图像与纹理的相异性很重要. 虽然纹理是自然图像的组成部分,但独立考虑时结构不同. 如Portilla & Simoncelli [17]所定义的,“视觉纹理的图像在空间上是同质的,通常包含重复结构,往往有一些随机变化(如随机位置、取向或颜色等)。” 相形之下,自然图像主要由平滑(低通)区域所组成[11]. 这种特征与纹理根本不同,可能或不会表现出光滑. 高频光谱信息的存在,也存在于噪声中,因此纹理去声具有挑战性. 在本文中,目标是验证和衡量SOTA深层凹陷器的性能,特别是纹理.

blocks.en: To benchmark the performance, SOTA denoising models, which have demonstrated exceptional performance in real-world image denoising, were selected — MIRNet [ 23 ] , MPRNet [ 24 ] , CAT [ 4 ] , CycleISP [ 22 ] , NAFNet [ 3 ] , and Restormer [ 25 ] . These models were evaluated for denoising performance on a texture dataset using the same noise levels as the original SOTA models. Subsequently, the models are fine-tuned on the texture dataset, and their performance is evaluated again. Fine-tuning was adopted instead of training from scratch, as training these models from scratch requires a substantially larger dataset, which was not available for the present study.
blocks.zh: 为衡量业绩,选择了SOTA去名模型,这些模型在现实世界图像去名化中表现出出类拔萃的表现——MIRNet [23],MPRNet [24],CAT [4],CycleISP [22],NAFNet [3],再起器 [25]. 这些模型被评价为在纹理数据集上使用与原始SOTA模型相同的噪声水平去命名性能. 随后,模型在纹理数据集上进行了微调,其性能再次得到评价. 采用了精细调整,而不是从零开始的培训,因为这些模型从零开始的培训需要一个大得多的数据集,而本研究没有这种数据集。

blocks.en: For qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the pre-trained and fine-tuned models, patches were extracted from the NUUR-Texture500 dataset [ 14 ] which contains 500 diverse and spatially consistent and uniform texture images spanning from regular patterns to stochastic ones. From each image in the NUUR-Texture500 dataset [ 14 ] , ten 256 × 256 256\times 256 patches were randomly sampled, yielding 5000 patches in total, split into 75% for training and 25% for validation. To simulate real-world noise conditions, noisy patches were generated by adding white Gaussian noise, with the noise standard deviation ( σ \sigma ) determined by estimating the average variance of noise in the noisy images of the SIDD dataset [ 1 ] . Our goal was to match the noise characteristics of the synthetic noisy texture patches with those found in real-world datasets such as SIDD, enabling a fair evaluation of denoising performance.
blocks.zh: 为了对经过预先培训和微调的模型进行定性和定量评价,从NUUR-Texture500数据集中提取了补丁[14],该数据集包含500个不同且空间一致和统一的纹理图像,从规律图案到有花纹图案。 从NUUR-Texture500数据集中的每个图像[14],随机抽取出10个256×256\times 256个补丁,共产生5000个补丁,分出75%用于培训,25%用于验证. 为了模拟现实世界的噪声条件,通过添加白高斯噪声来产生出吵闹的补丁,而噪声标准偏差( 83. sigma )是通过估计SIDD数据集噪声图像中噪声的平均相差[1]而确定的. 我们的目标是将合成噪音纹理补丁的噪声特征与诸如SIDD等现实世界数据集所发现的噪声特征相匹配,以便能够对去诺能性能进行公正的评价.

blocks.en: Six Nvidia A6000 GPUs were used to fine-tune the models using PyTorch. The fine-tuning of the denoisers is done using Adam Optimizer ( β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{2}=0.999 ) for 100 epochs with a batch size of 16. The initial learning rate is set to 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and a cosine annealing strategy is used to steadily reduce the learning rate to 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} during training. The loss function is chosen in accordance with the network architecture and the same objective used during training is retained for fine-tuning (e.g. ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} loss for CAT and Charbonnier loss for MPRNet).
blocks.zh: 6个 Nvidia A6000 GPU被用于使用PyTorch对模型进行微调. 对德诺瓦人进行微调时采用亚当·奥普利泽(β 1 = 0.9\β1\ 0.9;β 2 = 0.999\β2\ 0.999),为100个有批量尺寸为16个的纪元. 初始学习率被设定为1×10−4 1\times 10×4}在培训期间,采用相声反射策略,将学习率稳步降低到5×10−5 5\times 10×5}。 损失功能按照网络架构选择,培训中使用的相同目标被保留去微调(例如:CAT损失L 1\mathcal{L}_{1}和MPRNet的Charbonnier损失)。

blocks.en: TABLE I : Denoising performance (mean ± \pm std) on NUUR-Texture500 dataset [ 14 ] using PSNR, SSIM, MS-SSIM, CW-SSIM, DISTS, STSIM1, STSIM2 and LPIPS . Dagger ( † ) indicates fine-tuned models.

blocks.en: Performance is evaluated using both fidelity and perceptual metrics such as PSNR, SSIM, MS-SSIM [ 21 ] , CW-SSIM [ 18 ] , STSIM1 [ 28 ] , STSIM2 [ 28 ] , DISTS [ 6 ] and LPIPS [ 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 业绩评估使用忠贞度和感官度量,如PSNR、SSIM、MS-SSIM [21]、CW-SSIM [18]、STSIM1 [28]、STSIM2 [28]、DISTS [6]和LPIPS [27]。

blocks.en: Structural Texture Similarity (STSIM-1) captures texture similarity using local image statistics by replacing the structure term in SSIM with directional first-order autocorrelation of neighboring subband coefficients computed horizontally and vertically denoted by ρ 𝐱 ​ ( 0 , 1 ) \rho_{\mathbf{x}}(0,1) and ρ 𝐱 ​ ( 1 , 0 ) \rho_{\mathbf{x}}(1,0) respectively. c 𝐱 , 𝐲 ​ ( 0 , 1 ) = 1 − 0.5 ​ | ρ 𝐱 ​ ( 0 , 1 ) − ρ 𝐲 ​ ( 0 , 1 ) | c_{\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}}(0,1)=1-0.5\left|\rho_{\mathbf{x}}(0,1)-\rho_{\mathbf{y}}(0,1)\right| c 𝐱 , 𝐲 ​ ( 1 , 0 ) = 1 − 0.5 ​ | ρ 𝐱 ​ ( 1 , 0 ) − ρ 𝐲 ​ ( 1 , 0 ) | c_{\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}}(1,0)=1-0.5\left|\rho_{\mathbf{x}}(1,0)-\rho_{\mathbf{y}}(1,0)\right| The metric is calculated for each subband or patch and consolidated as follows: STSIM-1 ​ ( 𝐱 , 𝐲 ) = ( l ⁡ ( x , y ) ⋅ c ⁡ ( x , y ) ⋅ c 𝐱 , 𝐲 ​ ( 0 , 1 ) ⋅ c 𝐱 , 𝐲 ​ ( 1 , 0 ) ) 1 4 . {\text{STSIM-1}}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})=(l(x,y)\cdot c(x,y)\cdot c_{\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}}(0,1)\cdot c_{\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}}(1,0))^{\frac{1}{4}}.

STSIM-2 extends STSIM-1 by incorporating cross-band correlations. blocks.en: Deep Image Structure and Texture Similarity (DISTS) ) [ 6 ] is a deep learning-based metric that assesses the similarity of structural and texture information in images. It uses high-level perceptual features extracted from different layers of a pre-trained VGG network.
blocks.zh: 深图像结构与纹理相似性(DISTS) [6]是一个基于深层学习的度量衡,它评估了图像中结构和纹理信息的相似性. 它使用从预先训练的VGG网络的不同地层中取出的高级别感知特征.

blocks.en: Figure 2 presents a qualitative comparison of performance of various denoising models on texture images taken from the NUUR-Texture500 dataset. The corresponding quantitative results, averaged over the validation set, are reported in Table I in terms of PSNR, SSIM, STSIM1, STSIM2, and other metrics. The fine-tuned models demonstrate significant improvements across various performance metrics. Although the models were fine-tuned on pointwise losses (e.g. ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} ), they also exhibited improvements in non-pointwise perceptual metrics such as MS-SSIM, CW-SSIM, STSIM1, STSIM2 and DISTS. Fine-tuned models show a considerable increase in PSNR, ranging from +6.44 to +9.66 dB and subjective metric such as LPIPS shows an improvement of around -0.16 to -0.31 over the baseline models. This result clearly indicates that the baseline models are not adequately equipped to handle textures, and it is only upon fine-tuning, that the performance of the models can be improved significantly. Fine-tuned models also performed better across all the other structural similarity metrics (SSIM variants) and DISTS, indicating the importance of fine-tuning for achieving structurally and perceptually superior denoising performance. The performance improvement happens across multiple scales as indicated by the MS-SSIM metric. The STSIM1 and STSIM2 metrics, which assess structural and multi-scale structural similarity specifically for textures, also show consistent improvements ( +0.065 and +0.034 on average, respectively). Next, we carried out an evaluation of the fine-tuned denoising models on the original natural image datasets. The performance is reported in Table II . We observe that the models fine-tuned on the texture dataset do not perform as well on the original dataset. A visual demonstration is presented in Figure 3 . This result shows that, in the process of adaptation to the texture dataset, the models have catastrophically forgotten [ 13 ] the original dataset. The incongruence in performance suggests that natural images and texture images have low-dimensional embeddings that overlap minimally with each other. Thus, one can infer that textures have to be handled separately compared to other natural images. A unified denoising model that handles both texture images and other natural images equally well is an exciting direction for future research.
blocks.zh: 图2对从NUUR-Texture500数据集取自的纹理图像的各种去诺模型的性能进行了定性比较。 表一按PSNR、SSIM、STSIM1、STSIM2和其他衡量标准报告了与审定组平均相应的量化结果。 微调模型表明,各种业绩衡量标准都有了重大改进。 虽然这些模型在指针损失(如L 1\ mathcal{L}_{1})上进行了微调,但它们也在MS-SSIM,CW-SSIM,STSIM1,STSIM2和DISTS等非指针感知度量上表现出了改进. 微调模型显示PSNR有相当大的增长,从+6.44到+9.66分贝不等,而LPIPS等主观度量模型显示比基线模型改进了-0.16到-0.31左右. 这一结果明确显示,基线模型没有足够的设备来处理纹理,只有在微调后,模型的性能才能得到显著改善. 在所有其他结构相似度测量(SSIM变体)和DISTS中,微调模型也表现较好,表明微调对于实现结构上和观念上优越的去名性能的重要性. 如MS-SSIM衡量标准所示,业绩在多个尺度上都有所改进。 STSIM1和STSIM2的度量衡专门为纹理评估了结构和多尺度结构相似性,也显示出了一致的改进(平均分别为+0.065和+0.034). 接下来,我们对原始自然图像数据集上的微调解名模型进行了评估. 执行情况见表二。 我们看到,对纹理数据集进行微调的模型在原始数据集上表现不佳. 图3显示了视觉演示。 这一结果表明,在适应纹理数据集的过程中,模型已经灾难性地忘记了[13]原始数据集. 性能的不相通表明自然图像和纹理图像有低维嵌入,相重叠最小. 因此,我们可以推断出,与其他自然图像相比,纹理必须分别处理. 一个统一去诺的模型,能同样很好地处理纹理图像和其他自然图像,是未来研究的一个令人振奋的方向.

blocks.en: In this study, we benchmarked the performance of SOTA image-denoisers on a texture dataset. We have shown that off-the-shelf denoisers achieve subpar denoising performance on texture images compared to generic natural images. In our benchmarking, we have also compared the denoising performance using several metrics like STSIM1, STSIM-2 that capture textural nuances better than SSIM. We have fine-tuned the models on the texture dataset and showed that the texture denoising performance improves, but at the expense of significant degradation in performance on the original dataset . The study highlights the need for better denoisers that can handle textures better, either separately or along with general image datasets. However, it is to be noted that since the models were trained on point-by-point (e.g. ℒ 1 \mathcal{L}_{1} ) losses, further efforts are required to allow more extensive use of perceptual metrics, such as STSIM-M and STSIM-VGG, that do not operate on a point-by-point basis.
blocks.zh: 在这个研究中,我们把SOTA图像识别器在纹理数据集上的性能作为基准. 我们已经证明,与一般自然图象相比,现成的外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外层外 在我们的基准中,我们还用一些比SSIM更好的捕捉纹理细微分辨的测量标准,例如STSIM1,STSIM-2,来比较去诺能性能. 我们已经对纹理数据集的模型进行了微调,并显示纹理去诺能改善,但牺牲了原始数据集性能的重大退化。 研究强调,需要更好的能更好地分别或结合一般图像数据集处理纹理的外观。 然而需要注意的是,由于这些模型是按点来训练的(例如L 1\mathcal{L}_{1})损失,需要进一步努力允许更广泛地使用不按点来操作的感知度量,如STSIM-M和STSIM-VGG.

blocks.en: The next step in the study would be to design unified denoisers and train them on perceptual losses that are not point-by-point which can allow for a more holistic texture analysis. We believe that such unified denoisers can play a crucial role in the generation of natural images with rich texture in a diffusion or flow-based modelling framework.
blocks.zh: 研究的下一步是设计统一的分泌器,并培训它们了解不逐点的认知损失,从而能够进行更全面的纹理分析。 我们认为,这种统一的德诺瓦斯人可以在传播或流基建模框架内产生有丰富纹理的自然图像方面发挥关键作用.
